reviewed_qualifiers.observed: Online Exec targets generated launcher, absolute for standard/default absolute paths only. Relative --launcher-dir/XDG_BIN_HOME is not normalized. Frozen Exec=spacr has source-level ambiguity, with no actual OS stale selection observed.
C opens Terminal when private runtime is missing; helper privacy questions require TTY, consent not collected and non-dry-run. Existing runtime launch does not always prompt.

Helper supports SPACR_USER_INSTALL_ROOT but C launcher always picks default HOME runtime. Custom helper target is not guaranteed launchable by that C path; source mismatch only, no native failure/loop observed.

verdict: Three source flows and conditions agree: executable-only macOS gate/no-downgrade preservation; conditional Terminal questions; bare Linux Exec ambiguity versus conditionally absolute online launcher.
